jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead, grow, and empower a team of product managers building for our AI-powered litigation platform. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy and people leadership and is a great fit for a product leader who cares deeply about craft, is comfortable with technical ambiguity, and has a track record of shipping exceptional enterprise AI products.

This role will be responsible for Everlaw’s Platform Administration and Corporate Entry product area. This product area is focused on enabling large, complex organizations to adopt and scale Everlaw securely and covers enterprise onboarding and administration, legal holds administration and high-volume data collection, ingestion, and processing. In this role, you will act as the voice of the customer within the organization, ensuring products meet customer needs and expectations, and will engage directly with customers and industry stakeholders to gather insights and validate product concepts.

At Everlaw, our mission is to promote justice by illuminating truth . Our company culture is open and vibrant and we’re committed to the professional growth of our team members, offering an annual learning and development stipend and regular check-ins with managers regarding career goals. If you’re looking for a place that values passion, integrity, thinking big, and a desire to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

We do not believe in the ‘perfect’ candidate. If you’re passionate about the role and feel you can contribute meaningfully, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time position based in our Oakland, California office, with a hybrid schedule : in-office Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

How we're different

- Built for the AI Era: Everlaw has been committed to AI-assisted workflows for over a decade with tools like predictive coding and document clustering. We’ve continued this leadership into the generative AI era, with best-in-class features like Deep Dive and Coding Suggestions. We don’t layer AI onto our product - we architect intelligent, trustworthy systems grounded in enduring trust that deliver value to users every day.

- Culture and Growth at the Forefront: With a generous L&D budget, clearly codified values, and a commitment to long-term thinking, integrity and discipline, we create an environment where careers grow with intention and purpose.

- Thoughtful Onboarding: Our structured onboarding program ensures you understand our product, customers, and market and quickly integrates you into the team, setting you up to contribute thoughtfully from day one.

- Impact That Matters: Through Everlaw for Good, we offer our technology free or at heavily discounted rates to journalists, nonprofits, and pro bono attorneys to advance equitable access to justice beyond the boundaries of business.

In your role, you'll...

- Lead Product Strategy, Vision & Execution: Work with your team to define and own a multi-year strategy and roadmap aligned with company priorities and customer needs.

- Build a First-Class AI Product Experience : Guide PMs in ensuring our AI feature set is best in class for the dynamically evolving legal AI space. You’ll develop a deep understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and user behavior to inform prioritization decisions.

- Develop Product Talent: Lead and elevate a team of 3–6 product managers, fostering a culture of sharp analytical thinking and product excellence. Drive their success through clear feedback, mentorship and bespoke growth plans, while employing a consistent strategy for long-term career development.

- Elevate Product Craft: Model disciplined, critical use of AI across the full product development lifecycle, and develop AI-augmented ways of working with clear norms around when and how to soundly incorporate AI-generated output into the final work product.

- Scale and Drive Team Accountability: Grow the team through intentional hiring and operational refinement, while setting clear expectations and upholding our values and behavioral standards. Drive high performance and accountability, connecting work to the company vision and ensuring every PM is empowered to deliver measurable impact.

- Drive Cross-Functional Excellence: Partner with the design team to ensure user experience is a first-class citizen. Shepherd product development and enable go-to-market teams so they're armed to tell the right story and support customers with confidence. Identify R&D-wide process gaps and lead execution of improvements.

- Model People Leadership: Lead, motivate and influence others across your team and the business. You’ll serve as a senior PM stakeholder in leadership forums, business reviews, and executive presentations. You will drive cross-functional collaboration, and foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued.

About you

Required Experience

- You have at least 7 years of product management experience

- You have at least 3 years of experience managing teams of product managers

- Proven track record of defining product strategy and connecting it to measurable business outcomes

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data to uncover underlying business drivers and translate raw insights into strategic, timely product decisions

- Experience shipping products at scale in a fast-paced environment for sophisticated users and complex workflows (enterprise, B2B SaaS, data-heavy, or regulated domains)

- Experience building or managing ML or LLM-powered products, with a nuanced view of where AI genuinely compounds value for customers

- Excellent people and project management skills; process-driven with the ability to communicate complex concepts and drive teams toward a shared vision

- A strategic leader with a deep obsession for product craft and detail

Work Authorization

- You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that currently, Everlaw is not sponsoring employment visas for this role.

Total Rewards

- The expected salary range for this role is between $217,000 - $294,000. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate’s experience and skills. The base pay range is subject to change in the future.

- Participation in our equity program

- 401(k) retirement plan with company matching

- Health, dental, and vision insurance

- HSAs and FSAs for various expenses

- Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

- Paid parental leave and sick leave

- 17 paid vacation days plus 11 federal holidays

- Access to mental health and wellness resources like membership to Modern Health

- A generous L&D stipend for your personal growth

- Find out more about our Benefits and Perks

Perks

- A beautiful office in Uptown Oakland, just steps from the BART line and dozens of restaurants and walking distance to Lake Merritt

- Flexible work-from-home days on Tuesdays and Fridays

- Monthly home internet reimbursement

- Ability to select your hardware of choice (Mac or PC) and customize your desk setup

- A wide variety of snacks and beverages in the office

- Company-wide out-of-the-box events and fun activities with your team

- Time off for company-sponsored volunteer events and 4 paid hours per quarter to volunteer at a charitable organization of your choice

- Learning and career development opportunities (and a generous budget!)

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (Corporations)
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to define and execute the go-to-market strategy for in-house corporate legal teams and drive sales growth in this segment. You’ll bring strategic thinking, legal software expertise, and cross-functional collaboration skills to turn platform capabilities into persuasive positioning, drive campaigns, and influence product prioritization for our customers.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

- Own go-to-market strategy for selling Everlaw to legal teams, including messaging, positioning, battlecards, and sales materials (e.g. pitch decks, cheat sheets) that support the enterprise sales motion.

- Execute product launches for in-house corporate legal teams, developing launch campaigns and positioning, and managing sales enablement and go-live coordination.

- Partner with Demand Gen and Content to develop omni-channel campaigns and customer-facing collateral (webinars, blogs, whitepapers) that build thought leadership, generate pipeline and grow revenue.

- Research legal team needs and competitor approaches to identify where we're different and what drives buying decisions.

- Collaborate with Product and GTM on product prioritization and align on where we should invest and how to compete.

About You

- You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B product marketing, solutions marketing, product management, or related marketing roles, or at least 3 years in management consulting

- You have demonstrated ability to connect technical product capabilities to customer problems, outcomes, and business value, including experience marketing complex products to enterprise buyers.

- You bring a customer-centric mindset with a track record of articulating technical platform capabilities to solve real customer problems.

- You are an exceptional storyteller with strong written and verbal communication skills across both internal cross-functional teams and external audiences.

- You possess strong analytical capabilities to interpret quantitative and qualitative market research into actionable insights.

- You excel at building strong cross-functional partnerships and influencing teams without direct authority to drive programs to completion.

- You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

- You hold a Professional Degree, MBA, or JD.

- You have prior experience working in or serving the legal sector.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team – Marketing

The Marketing team shapes how Everlaw shows up in the world and connects the company's mission with the audiences it serves. Across brand, demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, content, web, design, communications, and public relations, the team turns complex ideas and customer successes into compelling stories and experiences. This work builds awareness, earns trust, and helps more organizations discover a better way to approach their most consequential legal work.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $141,000–$179,000. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.

Health & well-being

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

- Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

- Paid parental leave

- Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

- Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

- 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

- 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

- Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

- Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

- Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

- Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

- Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw: When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Engineering
jobs.description:
Everlaw is looking for a Technical Program Manager, Engineering to drive technical alignment, system ownership, and process enforcement across our Engineering team. In this high-visibility role, you will focus on Engineering Manager (EM) and Engineering Program Management (EPM) enablement, building self-service automation and tools that act as force multipliers across the entire organization. Ideally, you bring a background in software development within a program management function and a passion for turning complex technical requirements into elegant operational solutions.

This role sits within our Engineering department, where you will partner closely with senior engineering leadership to cultivate strategic relationships and unblock technical teams. You will bridge the gap between engineering infrastructure and business intelligence, helping to define and collect datasets that inform our data-driven decision-making. Your work will directly impact our engineering velocity, enabling multidisciplinary teams to execute with confidence, clarity, and autonomy.

Getting started

- We want you to feel like part of the team early on! Our onboarding process will integrate you into the company with informative sessions on our product, policies, processes, and team structure and goals.

- We’re excited for you to learn, grow, and contribute right away! We trust that you’ll bring experience and knowledge that will uplift and uplevel the team, but we don’t expect you to know everything on Day 1.

In your role, you'll...

- Partner with Software Engineers (SWEs) and Engineering Managers to define project scope, track dependencies, and remove blockers to drive multidisciplinary teams to successful project completion.

- Develop and refine roadmaps for your portfolio of operational programs, translating sparse requirements into concrete technical solutions aligned with yearly business objectives.

- Build automation-based workflows , workflow agents, and self-service tools within industry-standard engineering systems (such as AWS, Salesforce, Fivetran, Jira, and GitHub) to serve as organizational force multipliers.

- Define, collect, and sanitize raw usage data to design and implement business intelligence visualizations that inform data-driven decisions and measure program impact.

- Synthesize complex project information into accessible narratives, autonomously presenting deliverables tailored for engineering senior leadership and key stakeholders.

- Break down technical solutions into meaningful milestones, executing with high confidence and velocity across your program portfolio.

- Operate and deliver projects utilizing industry and project management best practices.

About you

- You have 2–3 years of experience as a Technical Program Manager (TPM) or in a similar technical program/project management function.

- You have a background in software development or a deep understanding of software engineering platforms and infrastructure architecture.

- You have domain expertise and working Python knowledge in relation to data structures, distributed systems, and business intelligence data analysis.

- You are proficient in navigating and leveraging tools like Jira, GitHub, AWS, Salesforce, or Fivetran to build modular data preparations and clean visualizations.

- You are a strategic relationship builder who can navigate team dynamics effectively, manage competing priorities, and smoothly unblock technical teams.

- You are an excellent communicator who can turn complex technical data into clear, accessible narratives for a variety of audiences.

- You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring employment visas for this role.

Benefits

- Compensation: The expected salary range for this role is between $140,000 - $215,000. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate’s experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

- Annual allocation for Learning & Development opportunities and applicable professional membership dues

Perks

- Enjoy a wide variety of snacks and beverages in the office

- One of Wealthfront’s 2021 Career Launching Companies, and ranked #2 on the “2022 Bay Area Best Places to Work” list by the San Francisco Business Times and the Silicon Valley Business Journal
